llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Vercel integration through Maton, with explicit approval rules for writes, credentials, and automation.

dimensions.detail: Network access, OAuth credential storage, and optional raw HTTP with MATON_API_KEY are sensitive but proportionate to Vercel API access and accompanied by credential-handling limits.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It instructs installing the pinned Maton CLI via npm or Homebrew and authenticating with Maton OAuth, which is expected for the integration and disclosed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions repeatedly default to read/list actions, require explicit user confirmation for connection creation and all writes, and treat undocumented endpoints as user-named only.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Hosted functions, triggers, trigger destinations, and local watch --exec can create persistent automation, but the artifact clearly labels these risks and requires separate user approval and scoping.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill can manage Vercel projects, deployments, domains, teams, and environment variables, including write and delete operations; that authority is coherent with the stated Vercel administration purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable authorizing Maton to access the chosen Vercel account. Use read/list calls first, confirm the exact account, project, domain, deployment, or environment variable before any write, and be especially cautious with functions, triggers, destinations, and MATON_API_KEY because they can persist or expose data if misused.
